name: B10-0133/2025 (ECR) – Escalation of violence in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the escalation of violence in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for an end to the violence in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. It condemns the M23 rebel group and Rwanda's support for it, and demands that M23 withdraw from captured territory and stop illegal mining. It asks the EU to sanction Rwandan officials and M23 commanders, to keep aid focused on women and children, and to make sure minerals imported from Rwanda are not fuelling the conflict. This is a statement of position, not a change in law.

- The EU is urged to sanction Rwandan officials and M23 commanders; this affects those named, not yet decided.
- Aid should prioritise women and children in eastern DRC; this affects how EU humanitarian money is spent.
- Minerals from Rwanda must be traceable; this affects EU importers and Congolese mining areas.
